alt: Close-up of the front of a Samsung Galaxy Tab S8 Ultra showing the dual front-facing cameras mounted in the V-shaped notch cutout at the top of the display — the same notch design confirmed to continue in the Tab S12 Ultra
story: Leaked renders published August 8–11, 2026 confirmed that the upcoming Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra will keep the exact same V-shaped display notch first introduced on the Tab S8 Ultra in 2022 — a design users have criticised as 'unsightly' for four years — while rivals moved to punch-hole or under-display cameras; tech outlets called it 'our worst fears confirmed.'
why_funny: Samsung spent four years listening to customers beg them to remove the notch from their premium 14.6-inch AMOLED display, then built the exact same notch again and called it a flagship.
